retrievalProfile.description: A mid-century portrait of a male musician featuring a vertical color-block sidebar and a large horizontal script overlay across the torso.
triggerTerms: retro musician portrait with vertical sidebar
excludeWhen: high-contrast black and white is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a male musician in a pinstripe suit holding a hollow-body electric guitar, set against a muted brown background with a contrasting red vertical sidebar on the right. The composition is defined by a large, light-colored script name overlapping the subject and a vertically stacked serif name within the sidebar.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered with a right-aligned vertical color block
Horizontal script text intersecting the vertical axis of the subject
Warm brown and red color palette with desaturated skin tones
Musical instrument providing a bright visual anchor in the lower quadrant
coreInvariants: Vertical sidebar on the right edge
Large script font overlaying the middle of the image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, centered horizontally, occupying 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow/orange hollow-body guitar in the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down to the large script overlay, then right to the vertical sidebar text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Muted brown studio background providing breathing room around the head and shoulders.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a warm, slightly faded value range typical of 1960s print.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and one primary accent color

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Combination of a fluid, wide-set script and a high-contrast transitional serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script: Thick-to-thin transitions, wide horizontal expansion, low x-height.
Serif: Vertical orientation, sharp serifs, high stroke contrast.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script 'G' with a large sweeping descender/loop
Stacked serif letters with wide tracking between characters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Fluid horizontal script contrasted against rigid vertical serif stacking.
graphicDevices: Solid color vertical bar on the right third of the frame

preserve: Horizontal script overlay of the first name

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century casual script feel
Provides the high-contrast serif look for the vertical text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a 1960s male musician in a pinstripe suit holding a yellow hollow-body guitar against a brown background, with a solid red vertical bar on the right side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, light-grey script name horizontally across the center and a black serif name stacked vertically inside the red bar.

verificationChecks: Is the script text overlapping the subject's suit?
Is the sidebar text stacked vertically with one letter per line?
Is the color palette muted and warm?
Does the subject look like a 1960s performer?

mustAchieve: Balanced use of vertical and horizontal axes

postGenerationChecks: Check that the vertical text is legible and properly spaced.
Ensure the script overlay doesn't obscure the subject's face.
Verify the guitar's color pops against the muted suit.
Confirm the red sidebar is a solid, clean block of color.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Musician) + Instrument(Hollow-body) + Layout(Vertical Sidebar) + Typography(Horizontal Script + Vertical Serif)
